page_title: LIV 3-1 WHU | Liverpool v West Ham 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Pablo Fornals (West Ham) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
90+4' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

90+4' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Chris Kavanagh with no other option than to blow for a foul. West Ham have a free kick.
90+3' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola is alert and denies him.
90+2' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. Nayef Aguerd (West Ham) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick to Liverpool.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
90' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
89' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) leaves the pitch and Wataru Endo comes on.
87' David Moyes prepares a substitution. Lucas Paqueta is replaced by Danny Ings (West Ham).
85' 3 - 1 GOAL - 3:1! The corner comes over and Virgil van Dijk flicks on with his head to Diogo Jota (Liverpool), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
85' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is about to take a corner kick.
82' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
81' We are about to witness a substitution. Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is replacing Luis Diaz.
81' Jurgen Klopp has decided to substitute Darwin Nunez and he is replaced by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
80' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
78' A snap shot by Pablo Fornals (West Ham) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Alisson produces a good save to thwart him.
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Curtis Jones will be replaced by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool).
77' There's an opportunity for Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
74' It's time for a substitution. Pablo Fornals comes on in place of Tomas Soucek (West Ham).
74' Here is a change. Michail Antonio (West Ham) is going off and David Moyes gives the last tactical orders to Mohammed Kudus.
71' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
70' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
66' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
65' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Luis Diaz, but Alphonse Areola displays great awareness to stop him.
62' Corner kick. Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is ready to send the ball into the box.
62' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Alphonse Areola thwarts him with a nice save. Now Liverpool have a corner.

60' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) scores with a brilliant shot into the left side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Alexis Mac Allister. The score is now 2:1.
59' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
58' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one.

55' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Alisson keeps the ball out.

53' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Mohamed Salah. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.

51' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
51' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
48' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
48' Half-chance! Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) plays a pass into the box, but Alphonse Areola reacts well to snuff out the attack. The ball is out of play and Liverpool manage to earn a corner.
46' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is flagged for offside.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Liverpool have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45+4' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Liverpool win a corner.
45+2' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) beats a few defenders in the penalty area and drives a low shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to make a wonderful save.
45+1' The Liverpool players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Chris Kavanagh signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
45+1' The Liverpool players joy may have been justified, because referee Chris Kavanagh is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' A goal, which was scored by Curtis Jones (Liverpool), was disallowed due to offside.

42' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) alters the score to 1:1. He jumps highest near the penalty spot to meet a good cross from Vladimir Coufal and steers a header in off the bottom of the left post. Alisson was helpless.
41' West Ham will take a corner kick.

40' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from West Ham comes to nothing. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, West Ham are going to take it.
40' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

39' That was close by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
37' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
36' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Edson Alvarez (West Ham) for his blatant foul.
33' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is able to continue to play.
33' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul. Liverpool win a free kick.

28' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.

27' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
25' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
22' Emerson (West Ham) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
22' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
20' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
20' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
19' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
16' 1 - 0 Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Alphonse Areola to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
16' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is going to take the penalty!
15' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul after Nayef Aguerd (West Ham) hacks down one of his opponents. PENALTY to Liverpool!
13' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
13' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Liverpool earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.

10' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. It's a free kick to West Ham in a dangerous position.

8' Michail Antonio (West Ham) outmuscles the defender near the penalty spot and get his head to a cross from Tomas Soucek. The accuracy is lacking, however, and the ball spins well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
7' West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

7' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Alisson dived superbly to block the header from around the penalty spot, which was aimed straight towards the bottom left corner by Tomas Soucek (West Ham). West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
4' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
4' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. That's a free kick to Liverpool.
1' Flag goes up against Michail Antonio (West Ham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The match has just started.
West Ham will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Chris Kavanagh.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
